import hashlib,json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
import numpy as np
import torch
from benchmarks.cases import CASES
from scripts.benchmark_robin_execution import load_model

trial=Path('numerical-reports/robin-sampling-2048-001/heat_neumann3d-19')
original=json.loads((trial/'result.json').read_text());case=CASES[original['case']]
torch.set_num_threads(1)
factory,model=load_model(trial,'eager',original.get('hard_lifting','recursive'),'cuda')
generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(20261016)
x=torch.rand((128,case.dimensions),generator=generator)
times=(0.,0.125,0.25,0.375,0.5)
values={};residuals={};references={}
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False
torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False
torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest')
started=time.perf_counter()
for name,dtype in (('float32',torch.float32),('float64',torch.float64)):
 model=model.to(dtype=dtype)
 values[name]=[];residuals[name]=[]
 for clock in times:
  columns=[x[:,i:i+1].to(device='cuda',dtype=dtype).detach().requires_grad_() for i in range(case.dimensions)]
  t=torch.full((len(x),1),clock,dtype=dtype,device='cuda',requires_grad=True)
  with torch.enable_grad():
   output=dict(model(columns,t))
   r=factory.adapter.residuals(output,*columns,t)['heat']
  values[name].append(output['u'].detach().cpu().double().numpy())
  residuals[name].append(r.detach().cpu().double().numpy())
  if name=='float32':
   references[clock]=case.reference({a:x[:,i:i+1].double().numpy() for i,a in enumerate(factory.settings.domain.space)},np.full((len(x),1),clock))
rows=[]
for i,clock in enumerate(times):
 a,b=values['float32'][i],values['float64'][i]
 ra,rb=residuals['float32'][i],residuals['float64'][i]
 rms=lambda v:float(np.sqrt(np.mean(v**2)))
 rows.append(dict(time=clock,temperature_fp32_fp64_rms=rms(a-b),temperature_fp32_fp64_max=float(np.max(np.abs(a-b))),temperature_error_fp32_rms=rms(a-references[clock]),temperature_error_fp64_rms=rms(b-references[clock]),residual_fp32_rms=rms(ra),residual_fp64_rms=rms(rb),residual_fp32_fp64_rms=rms(ra-rb),residual_fp32_fp64_max=float(np.max(np.abs(ra-rb)))))
report=dict(float32_matmul_precision=torch.get_float32_matmul_precision(),cuda_matmul_allow_tf32=torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32,contract=1,case=case.name,seed=original['seed'],checkpoint_sha256=hashlib.sha256((trial/'training/checkpoints/final.ckpt').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),device='cuda',torch=torch.__version__,points_per_time=len(x),times=times,coordinate_seed=20261016,rows=rows,analysis_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,limitations='CUDA arithmetic diagnosis of one frozen CUDA-trained checkpoint; not a performance benchmark or acceptance. FP32 weights converted exactly to FP64, coordinates generated once in FP32 then cast exactly. Independent eager physical derivatives. Finite random spatial sample, not a global bound; FP64 evaluation is not FP64 training and does not explain CUDA optimization trajectory differences.')
Path('numerical-reports/precision-diagnosis-cuda-001.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False))
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
